cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Does the order of executing the callback and setting the flag matter? Mostly asking because this order is changed now even with the feature flag turned off.

evidence.thread_resolution: acdlite: Yeah that's a good point, I suppose it should come before so that the flag gets turned off even if there's an error. Looks like we don't have a test for that.
